verdict.rationale: Form-factor coverage is a fair question for a hardware security key, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents USB-C versus USB-A models or keychain versus nano form factors. The only nearby items are a community remark that Yubico hardware is compact and an SDK note that USB and NFC keys are supported; neither describes the port or carry-style lineup, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power user, the lineup covers my ports and carry style — USB-C and USB-A models, keychain and low-profile nano form factors
